nodes.description: Privileged owner address; set in constructor from msg.sender and used as the sole access-control gate for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated in transferFrom and batchSend with raw unchecked arithmetic and in the constructor with the initial supply.
Public nested allowance mapping; decremented in transferFrom and granted unlimited to the router in the constructor.
Private mapping counting how many sale transfers each address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private whitelist mapping consulted in ensure to bypass all sale restrictions for privileged addresses.
Minimum sale amount in wei; set by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount in wei; set by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum number of sale transactions allowed per address; set by init and enforced in condition.
Owner-controlled whitelisted address that is exempted from sale restrictions inside ensure.
Public total token supply set once in the constructor from the deployer-supplied supply value.
Constant 18 decimals used when scaling _minSale/_maxSale and the total supply.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 Router constant address used as an implicit whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine: spends allowance, calls ensure, mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Whitelist gate: returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition.
Sale-limit validation reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that delegatecalls an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executing untrusted code in the token's storage context.
Owner-only sale configuration setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only air-drop loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and credits recipients.
Owner-only setter that installs an address into the ensure whitelist.
Pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB via CREATE2-style hashing.
Constructor minting the entire supply to msg.sender, setting owner, name, symbol and an unlimited router allowance.
External caller identity; drives transfer, transferFrom authorization, approve and every owner-only privileged function.
Low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata inside delegate(), executing arbitrary code with full storage control.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom, only guarded by a single require.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom causing allowance corruption on failed require ordering.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend used for the balance debit check.
Recipient argument of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount argument of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address argument of transferFrom, used for allowance, whitelist and balance accounting.
Recipient address argument of transferFrom credited with the amount.
Value argument of transferFrom subtracted from allowance and balanceOf.
Spender argument of approve written into the allowance mapping.
Amount argument of approve stored as the new allowance.
Attacker-influenced target address passed to delegatecall by delegate.
Attacker-influenced calldata passed to delegatecall by delegate.
Sale count limit argument of init written into _saleNum.
Minimum sale amount argument of init scaled into _minSale.
Maximum sale amount argument of init scaled into _maxSale.
Recipient array argument of batchSend; its length multiplies into the unchecked total.
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend used in the unchecked multiplication and credits.
Address argument of setTradeAddress stored into the whitelist state variable tradeAddress.
Source argument of ensure compared against the whitelist and passed to condition.
Destination argument of ensure compared against owner and UNI.
Value argument of ensure forwarded to condition for sale-limit checks.
Source argument of condition indexing _onSaleNum.
Value argument of condition compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Local total = _value * _tos.length used as the required balance in batchSend.
Loop index over the _tos array in batchSend.
Loop-local recipient _to credited inside batchSend.
Local computed Uniswap pair address checked against _from in ensure.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the owner key of the allowance mapping in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring the sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before minting credits to arbitrary addresses.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before extending the whitelist.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
_to recipient parameter flows into transfer.
_value amount parameter flows into transfer.
transfer forwards its _value argument to transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _to argument to transferFrom as the recipient.
_from selects the allowance and balance entries mutated in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
_spender is the allowance key written in approve.
_value is the allowance amount written in approve.
parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
arbitrary address a reaches the delegatecall operation.
arbitrary calldata b reaches the delegatecall operation.
delegate unconditionally reaches the low-level delegatecall operation.
the delegatecall invokes external code that runs in this contract's storage context.
delegatecall can overwrite the owner storage slot and any other state variable.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
_minSale is produced by unchecked token*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.
_maxSale is produced by unchecked maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.
init writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
_tos recipient array drives the batchSend loop.
_value is the per-recipient credit in batchSend.
batchSend directly executes the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
_value is a multiplicand of the unchecked total in batchSend.
_tos.length is a multiplicand of the unchecked total in batchSend.
the overflowed total is used to debit balanceOf[msg.sender] and can differ from the credited sum.
addr parameter is stored by setTradeAddress.
the owner installs an arbitrary address into the whitelist state variable tradeAddress.
tradeAddress is compared in ensure and allows its holder to bypass all sale restrictions.
_from is validated against owner, UNI, pair and canSale in ensure.
_to is compared against owner and UNI in ensure.
_value is passed into condition by ensure.
when no whitelist match is found ensure delegates the decision to condition.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
the _onSaleNum counter feeds the sale limit decision in condition.
canSale[_from] is read in ensure and grants a full restriction bypass.
ensure indexes the canSale whitelist mapping.
_minSale bounds the accepted sale value in condition.
_maxSale bounds the accepted sale value in condition.
_saleNum bounds the number of sales allowed per address in condition.
transferFrom requires ensure(...) before completing the transfer, making the whitelist logic security critical.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom mutates allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transfer has no logic of its own and delegates entirely to transferFrom.
pairFor computes the expected Uniswap pair address consumed by the whitelist check in ensure.
the constructor sets owner from msg.sender granting unrestricted privileged control.
the constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full total supply.
the constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address.
local total is computed and compared against balanceOf in batchSend.
local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication operation.
loop index i walks the _tos parameter array in batchSend.
loop-local _to is written into balanceOf in batchSend.
local pair address is compared against _from in ensure, allowing the attacker-held pair address to bypass restrictions.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a value argument used only to forward into transferFrom from transfer.
_value is a value argument used only to forward into transferFrom from transfer.
_from is an access-control/state-selector argument consumed only by transferFrom.
_to is a destination argument consumed only by transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balanceOf subtraction, so it folds into the unsafe operation.
_spender is a mapping-key argument consumed only by approve.
_value is the allowance value argument consumed only by approve.
a is the raw target address of the delegatecall and carries no independent semantics.
b is the raw calldata of the delegatecall and carries no independent semantics.
saleNum is a configuration argument stored by init.
token is a configuration argument scaled into _minSale by init.
maxToken is a configuration argument scaled into _maxSale by init.
_tos is only used for its length and iteration inside the unchecked batchSend computation.
_value is the multiplicand and credit amount of the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
addr is a single-purpose setter argument consumed only by setTradeAddress.
_from is the whitelist subject argument consumed only by ensure.
_to is the whitelist comparison argument consumed only by ensure.
_value is only forwarded from ensure to condition for limit checks.
_from is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is only compared against the sale bounds inside condition.
total exists solely to hold the result of the unchecked multiplication.
i is a loop induction variable with no independent security meaning.
_to is a loop-local alias of an element of the _tos array.
the locally computed pair address is only used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
